x: Sapcote, Frank Tasker, Ted Evans and in particular D. Skinner, who made it quite clear that he is going to develop into a very useful team man.

Ted Evans, walking as an individual at his own expense for experience sake, showed up to advantage. Although all our lads fought well, Sheffield crawled closer and when Tony was pulled at eight miles, we dropped back to third place.
Led by Pat Sapcote (3rd), the rest of the team comprised Ted Evans (9th), George Atkinson (13th) and Hugh McGreechan (16th), one of our newest members.
Ted Evans writes from Dover. Says he is likely to be there another three years and although he is keeping fit, is unable to get to London for racing, but hopes to do the Brighton Walk.
